name: Singapore analyst moving from contract to permanent work

context.employment_state: Contract ending; actively seeking next position
constraints: Explicit employer wording on local work eligibility
Needs a start date compatible with contract end
context.company_awareness: Some regional employers known; also searches regional FP&A and business-finance titles.

trigger: A contract extension is declined, prompting a search for permanent regional roles rather than another short engagement.

searches_run.query: finance business analyst permanent hybrid Singapore regional
searches_run.observation: Retrieved recruiter listings explicitly labelled permanent/hybrid and a direct Campari regional finance posting. The inspected employer page stated hybrid and APAC responsibilities but did not establish a precise office schedule or local-work eligibility.

searches_run.query: business analyst Singapore jobs existing right to work permanent hybrid
searches_run.observation: Combined results largely remained ordinary finance/analyst vacancies; retrieved snippets did not resolve the specific eligibility requirement. Absence of eligibility wording is not permission or a rejection.

sources.title: Regional Finance Analyst APAC | Campari Group
sources.supports: Direct inspection shows Singapore hybrid role, regional reporting and finance/accounting responsibilities; eligibility and exact hybrid pattern remain unknown.

sources.title: Senior Financial Analyst West Hybrid | Randstad Singapore
sources.supports: Retrieved recruiter listing states permanent and regional business-performance work; no independent availability check.

sources.title: Hybrid Finance Business Analyst jobs Singapore | eFinancialCareers
sources.supports: Retrieved specialist job-search page combines hybrid and permanent labels; eligibility detail was not established.

best_entry_page.primary_query: permanent hybrid finance analyst jobs Singapore
best_entry_page.promise: Find covered employers and compare permanent status, regional responsibilities and hybrid wording while keeping unstated eligibility details visible as unknown.
best_entry_page.cta: Search permanent hybrid analyst roles and save selected regional employers.
proof_needed: Separate finance analyst, FP&A and IT business-analysis responsibilities
Exact source eligibility wording without immigration conclusions
Hybrid and start-date evidence where stated

conversion_objections: Business analyst often means IT systems rather than finance.
Full-time does not necessarily mean permanent.
Regional role does not prove regional-HQ decision-making exposure.
I cannot spend days applying where eligibility requirements are unstated.
I need vacancies now, not only future alerts.

avoid_targeting.reason: Immigration determinations are outside this product.
No employer eligibility or sponsorship guarantee.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I need a permanent role before my contract ends, and the first screen should tell me what is actually known. Keep finance work separate from generic IT business analysis and show exact eligibility wording instead of guessing.
